people.name: Dawn Deborah Jurkovich
people.bio_note: President and Founding Partner of Releve Financial Group. Over 20 years of experience; holds CFP, CRPC, and BFA (Behavioral Financial Advisor) designations — described as the nation's first certified Behavioral Financial Advisor. Created the 'WELLthy360' approach and authored 'Live WELLthy.' Recognized as a nationally recognized keynote speaker on values-aligned wealth and leadership. Also serves as CFO and Designer for a real estate venture, D2 Legacy, LLC. Listed as a member of the Forbes Finance Council.
people.bio_source: Forbes Finance Council member profile (councils.forbes.com/profile/Dawn-Dahlby-Jurkovich) — independent, non-firm-website source confirming credentials, authorship, and speaking recognition; corroborated by Wealthminder.com and firm website
people.phase4_note: Phase 4 verification (2026-07-03): the 'nation's first certified Behavioral Financial Advisor' claim and 'WELLthy360' branding trace only to her own self-authored bio copy (repeated across her Forbes profile and personal site) -- no independent third party (e.g. the BFA certifying body) confirms the 'first' superlative. Also note: her book 'Live WELLthy' is published under the name 'Dawn Dahlby,' not 'Jurkovich' -- confirmed to be the same person via her hyphenated Forbes profile (Dahlby-Jurkovich), not a different individual. Verdict: PARTIAL.

people.name: Kimberly Karen Bannwarth
people.bio_note: Chief Compliance Officer; also holds title Managing Director/Vice President per LinkedIn/ZoomInfo. Holds CRPC (Chartered Retirement Planning Counselor) designation. Prior roles in Client Services management at NorthRock Partners and Ameriprise Financial. Holds a Master's degree from St. Cloud State University and a Bachelor of Music Education from the University of Wisconsin-Eau Claire — a notable career pivot from music education into wealth management operations/compliance.
people.bio_source: LinkedIn and ZoomInfo profile, corroborating career history and education beyond the firm website

firm_note.text: Founded by Dawn Dahlby-Jurkovich, positioned as a concierge fiduciary practice blending financial strategy with behavioral finance, with a stated focus on serving women and their families. Dawn splits time between Minnesota and Arizona offices.
firm_note.source: Firm website (relevefinancialgroup.com); corroborated by Forbes Finance Council profile
